handlers.name: handleBuildMessage
handlers.body_summary:
(message: any) => {
    switch (message.type) {
      case 'output':
        addOutput(message.content, detectOutputType(message.content))
        break

      case 'progress':
        setBuildProgress(message.progress)
        break

      case 'complete':
        const success = message.exitCode === 0
        setBuildStatus(success ? 'success' : 'failed')
        addOutput('', 'default')
        addOutput(
          success
            ? `[SUCCESS] Build completed in ${formatDuration(message.duration)}`
            : `[FAILED] Build failed with exit code ${message.exitCode}`,
          success ? 'success' : 'error'
        )

        if (currentTask) {
          const historyItem: BuildHistory = {
            id: `history-${Date.now()}`,
            taskId: currentTask.id,
            taskName: currentTask.name,
            status: success ? 'success' : 'failed',
            startTime: new Date(Date.now() - message.duration),
            endTime: new Date(),
            duration: message.duration,
            exitCode: message.exitCode,
          }
          setBuildHistory((prev) => [historyItem, ...prev.slice(0, 19)])
        }
        break

      case 'error':
        addOutput(`[ERROR] ${message.message}`, 'error')
        setBuildStatus('failed')
        break
    }
  }

import React from 'react'
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  Button,
} from '@persona-framework/ui'
import { AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react'
import { FocusTrap } from './FocusTrap'

interface ConfirmDialogProps {
  open: boolean
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void
  title: string
  description: string
  confirmLabel?: string
  cancelLabel?: string
  onConfirm: () => void
  onCancel?: () => void
  variant?: 'default' | 'destructive'
  isLoading?: boolean
}

export function ConfirmDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  title,
  description,
  confirmLabel = 'Confirm',
  cancelLabel = 'Cancel',
  onConfirm,
  onCancel,
  variant = 'default',
  isLoading = false,
}: ConfirmDialogProps) {
  const handleCancel = () => {
    onCancel?.()
    onOpenChange(false)
  }

  const handleConfirm = () => {
    onConfirm()
    if (!isLoading) {
      onOpenChange(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent
        className="max-w-[400px] w-[90vw] p-5 bg-[#252526] border border-[#3c3c3c]"
        role="alertdialog"
        aria-labelledby="confirm-dialog-title"
        aria-describedby="confirm-dialog-description"
      >
        <FocusTrap active={open}>
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle
              id="confirm-dialog-title"
              className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold text-[#cccccc]"
            >
              {variant === 'destructive' && (
                <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-[#f48771]" aria-hidden="true" />
              )}
              {title}
            </DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription
              id="confirm-dialog-description"
              className="text-[#858585] text-sm mt-2"
            >
              {description}
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>

          <DialogFooter className="flex justify-end gap-2 mt-4">
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              onClick={handleCancel}
              disabled={isLoading}
            >
              {cancelLabel}
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant={variant === 'destructive' ? 'destructive' : 'default'}
              onClick={handleConfirm}
              disabled={isLoading}
              aria-busy={isLoading}
            >
              {isLoading ? 'Please wait...' : confirmLabel}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </FocusTrap>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  )
}

function requestToEndpoint(saved: SavedRequest): DiscoveredEndpoint {
  const url = new URL(saved.request.url.startsWith('http') ? saved.request.url : `http://localhost${saved.request.url}`)

  return {
    method: saved.request.method,
    path: url.pathname,
    file: 'collection',
    line: 0,
    handler: saved.name.replace(/\s+/g, ''),
    description: saved.description || saved.name,
    params: saved.request.pathVariables
      .filter(p => p.enabled)
      .map(p => p.key),
    queryParams: saved.request.queryParams
      .filter(p => p.enabled)
      .map(p => p.key),
  }
}
